description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


Fix the app permanently failing to launch after a settings file corruption
- Fixed the app never opening again (window flashing and closing instantly) once its settings file got corrupted, e.g. by a crash or power loss during a save: a broken settings file is now backed up and reset at startup instead of crashing the app before any window appears
- Settings are now saved atomically (write to a temporary file, then rename), so an interrupted save can no longer corrupt the settings file in the first place
